messages:
Anya K: Following up on last night's span-loss postmortem. We saw missing spans (~10-20%) for ~50m. Pattern: ETL checkpoint skip + aggregator aggregation change. Need concrete owners and timelines for fixes.

Mike L: I'll take aggregator fix. Plan: revert faulty aggregation patch and add tests preventing over-deduping. Opening INF-3601. ETA revert + canary 3h.

Jordan (Data Eng): I'll handle ETL checkpoint robustness. Observed GC pause on worker-5 that skipped commits. Plan: restart worker, run targeted backfill, add watermark sanity alert. Opening INF-3602. ETA backfill started; full catch-up ~24-36h.

Priya S: I'll own deploy hygiene changes: add canary gating for span-rate within +/-5% for 15m before promote. Creating INF-3603. ETA 5 business days for automation.

Elaine: Updating runbook with a "Span gap response" checklist and adding a recurring 6-week review. RB-4350 created.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-192 created and linked to INF-3601, INF-3602, INF-3603, RB-4350. Pager notified.

Anya K: Owners assigned: Mike=aggregator, Jordan=ETL/backfill+monitoring, Priya=deploy gating, Elaine=runbook. Please add due dates to the PM doc and mark status. Closure criteria: backfill done, runbook updated, gating in place, and no missing_spans alerts for 14 days.

Mike L: Revert pushed; canary counts back to baseline. INF-3601 updated with PR link.

Jordan (Data Eng): Backfill in progress for shard-5. Monitoring added: dashboard /dash/spans/health and alert missing_spans_rate >0.05 for 10m -> page. Synthetic span producer added to staging CI.

Priya S: INF-3603 created. Will prototype gating this week; ETA for rollout to prod gating 5 business days.

Elaine: Runbook updated and meeting invite sent.

Anya K: Great. Please post progress updates in the postmortem doc and ping in #incidents if anything regresses. We'll reconvene after backfill completes.
